offence_description: Aggravated sexual assault and choking to enable sexual assault

name: R. v. Ricciardi

note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed.

name: R. v. Bourque
offence_description: Manslaughter by injecting boyfriend with morphine

offence_description: Introducing narcotics into a penitentiary
sentence_quote: imposing an 18 month conditional sentence
note: Joint submission; leave granted, appeal dismissed.

name: R. v. C.L.
offence_description: Sexual assault causing bodily harm, choking, threat, breach of recognizance

name: R. v. Pyke
offence_description: Attempted murder and other serious offences, stabbing

offence_description: Child luring and communicating to obtain sexual services from minor

offence_description: Sexual assault of taxi passenger

note: 2.5y and 4y concurrent; victim surcharge waived; weapons prohibition 10 years.

name: R. v. Holt
offence_description: Possession of loaded restricted firearm; occupant of vehicle with firearm

offence_description: Fraud over $5,000 against OHIP by physician

offence_description: Offence not shown in endorsement

note: Six months CSO with house arrest then curfew; 10 year s.109 and SOIRA

name: R. v. Cotterell
offence_description: Robbery
sentence_quote: we would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal and vary the sentence to one of two years and three months.
note: Two years three months in addition to nine months pretrial credit; first penitentiary sentence principle applied.

name: R. v. Wilkinson
offence_description: Fentanyl and other drug trafficking; possession of prohibited firearm
sentence_quote: I reduce your sentence to six years for all counts on the two indictments.
note: Credit calculation corrected in court; final figures 961 days credit, 1,229 days remaining.

name: R. v. Uppal
offence_description: Manslaughter as setup man in killing
sentence_quote: Having concluded seven years is the fit sentence in these circumstances, and taking into account the almost two years you have been in prison, I sentence you, for your criminal involvement in the death of Gurpreet Sohi, to five years in prison.
note: Credit one-for-one for about two years.

name: R. v. Butler
offence_description: Attempted fraud on an estate using forged documents
sentence_quote: Mr. Butler received an 18-month conditional sentence plus 12 months’ probation
note: Co-accused Hammond's 90-day conditional sentence upheld in a separate endorsement.

name: R. v. Golar
offence_description: Manslaughter by stabbing
sentence_quote: I sentence you, Ms. Golar, to five years and three months further incarceration. From that will be subtracted the 17 months that you have already served.
note: Total 63 months less 17 months gives 46 months to serve.

name: R. v. Hatt
offence_description: Marihuana production and possession, firearms offences, illegal cigarettes
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the sentence imposed by the trial judge is varied and a sentence of time served is substituted.
note: Global sentence three months equals time served; excise fines and ancillary orders not appealed, amounts not shown.

name: R. v. Gabriel
offence_description: Second degree murder with a handgun
sentence_quote: The period of parole ineligibility is then set at 13 years. The ancillary orders for DNA and a lifetime weapons prohibition will be granted.
mitigating_quote: His decision to remain in Mulgrave Park, to get a gun rather than to call the police and to seek out the confrontation with Ryan White make no sense at all unless they are considered in light of his background.
note: African Nova Scotian and Mi'kmaq; court endorsed warrant to serve in Ontario and culturally appropriate counselling.

name: R. v. Wolfe
offence_description: Criminal negligence causing death and bodily harm by driving; dangerous driving
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the appellant to a global period of imprisonment of 6 years and imposed driving prohibition orders of 10 years on each count of criminal negligence causing death and 7 years on the count of criminal negligence causing bodily harm, along with a DNA order
note: Majority set aside the driving prohibitions as unlawful; six-year term stood; dissent ignored.

name: R. v. Bordbar
offence_description: Robberies, break and enter, sexual assault with weapon, choking, theft, masking
sentence_quote: The global sentence I impose for your crimes is 12 years of imprisonment.
note: SOIRA and weapons prohibition for life; Kienapple conditional stays on counts 14 and 15.

name: R. v. Scott
offence_description: Robbery as driver of getaway car
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal, and suspend the passing of sentence and impose a probationary term for the maximum of three years.
note: Two years less a day jail replaced by suspended sentence; counselling required; s. 100 prohibition confirmed.

name: R. v. Amare
offence_description: Possession of MDMA for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: we are of the view that the sentence of four years imprisonment was neither harsh nor excessive.

name: R. v. Ibrahim
offence_description: Offences not shown; conviction after police chase and identification
sentence_quote: we allow the sentence appeal to the extent of increasing credit for pre-trial custody to four years, six months (two years, three months x 2), resulting in a net sentence of three years, nine months.
note: Offences not stated; credit increased from 1.5:1 to 2:1.

name: R. v. Dawson; R. v. Ross
offence_description: Fraud over $5000 on DND; conferring benefit on government employee
co_offenders: Ross: 36 months penitentiary (fraud)
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, set aside the conditional sentences imposed by the trial judge and substitute, in Mr. Ross’ case, a 36-month penitentiary term, and in Mr. Dawson’s case, a 42-month penitentiary term
note: Conditional sentences of two years less a day replaced; one-to-one credit for time on conditional sentence, amount not stated.

name: R. v. Dunn
offence_description: Aggravated assault causing brain damage
sentence_quote: I would, therefore, grant leave to appeal sentence but dismiss the appeal as to sentence.
note: Nine-year sentence; 15.5 months pre-trial custody mentioned, credit not stated.

name: R. v. LeBlanc
offence_description: Conspiracy to commit murder and attempted murder
sentence_quote: So the bottom line is a sentence of 10 years to be served consecutively to the earlier 16 years.
note: 10 years concurrent per count, consecutive to existing 16-year sentence (26 total); no remand credit.

name: R. v. Patrick
offence_description: Sexual assault causing bodily harm; unlawful confinement
alt_institution_name: VisionQuest or Houston Gospel Home of Hope
sentence_quote: I therefore sentence Mr. Patrick to a term of five years' incarceration for the sexual assault causing bodily harm and one-year consecutive for the unlawful confinement.
mitigating_quote: I have taken into account the Gladue factors and the reduced cognitive ability of Mr. Patrick
note: Placement recommended for early release or parole; credit 327 days at 1.5 to 1.

name: R. v. Wall
offence_description: Manslaughter with a firearm
sentence_quote: I have determined that a fit and proper sentence to impose upon you for having committed manslaughter in the death of Earl Seymour is 14 years imprisonment.
note: Provocation reduced culpability somewhat; victim surcharge waived; weapons prohibition 10 years and life.

name: R. v. Larche
offence_description: Conspiracy to export cannabis for criminal organization; related count
sentence_quote: the three-year sentence imposed by the trial judge was increased to six years
note: SCC dismissed both appeals on s. 725 point; six-year sentence from Court of Appeal stands, inferred from excerpts.

name: R. v. Stack
offence_description: Internet child luring; breach of recognizance and undertaking
sentence_quote: On May 19, 2021, the appellant was sentenced to two years’ imprisonment.
note: Two years for luring plus four months for breaches after totality; unclear if consecutive; four months credit.

name: R. v. Laforme
offence_description: Second-degree murder
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to life imprisonment with a 16-year period of parole ineligibility.
mitigating_quote: He recognized that factors such as Mr. Laforme’s advanced age and the Gladue considerations augured in favour of a shorter ineligibility period.
note: Leave to appeal sentence granted; sentence appeal dismissed.

name: R. v. Sutherland
offence_description: Conspiracy to commit robbery
sentence_quote: I conclude that suspending the passing of sentence and placing Ms. Sutherland on probation for a period of thirty-six months
note: Probation includes 12 months house arrest then 12 months curfew; victim surcharge not imposed.

name: R. v. Endean
offence_description: Loaded restricted firearm, obliterated serial number, possession while prohibited
sentence_quote: we cannot in my view say that the sentencing judge in this case erred in giving primary weight to denunciation and deterrence or that the four-year term of imprisonment on the first charge was not fit.
note: Four years plus six months consecutive before credit; credit amount not shown.

name: R. v. Buchanan
offence_description: Manslaughter (provoked killing)
sentence_quote: a just, fit, and proportionate sentence is one of six years and 4.5 months' imprisonment. From this sentence, I deduct the equivalent of four years and 4.5 months that you have served in pretrial detention.
note: Victim surcharge waived; psychiatric intake is a probation condition only.

name: R. v. ElGebeily
offence_description: Sexual assault (touching, low end)
sentence_quote: I feel a conditional discharge with 12 months probation including the conditions recommended by Crown Counsel in her original brief filed with the Court on June 7, 2021
note: SOIRA order denied; DNA order granted.

name: R. v. Johnson
offence_description: Assault with weapon (vehicle) and dangerous driving
sentence_quote: On the first count of the indictment, you will serve a period of imprisonment of twelve months, less credit for pre-sentencing time served, calculated as a credit of 1.5 days for each day served.
note: Credit at 1.5:1 but days not shown; hate-motivation finding not shown in excerpts; 30 days concurrent on count 2.

name: R. v. Gamble
offence_description: Attempt break and enter, possession of stolen property, break-in instruments
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to two years less a day imprisonment and 3 years’ probation, concurrent on all three charges.
note: Trial judge erred in denying credit for 5 months pre-trial custody but sentence not unfit.

name: R. v. Durfy
offence_description: Uttering a forged document (real estate agent)
sentence_quote: He was fined $5000 and sentenced to twelve months probation.
note: Conditional discharge refused on appeal.

name: R. v. Lagimodiere
offence_description: Possession of handgun and ammunition; related firearm possession
sentence_quote: vary the sentence on Count 5 to 18 months' imprisonment concurrent, without credit, and vary the sentence on Count 7 to one year and 303 days' imprisonment.
note: Count 7 now 1y 303d after enhanced credit; unclear whether that figure is before or after credit.

name: R. v. U. A.
offence_description: Sexual assault of cellmate (forced oral sex)
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the appellant to four years’ imprisonment, less 267 days’ credit for pre-sentence custody (178 days credited at 1.5:1), resulting in 39 months to be served.
note: Sentence appeal dismissed except victim surcharge set aside; other ancillary orders not described.

name: R. v. D.V.B.
offence_description: Sexual assault of four-year-old child; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: I am not persuaded that the sentencing judge erred, either in declaring the appellant to be a dangerous offender, or in sentencing him to an indeterminate period of detention.
note: Guilty plea also to breach of probation; cognitive limitations noted as sad circumstance.

name: R. v. Anderson
offence_description: Loaded restricted firearm possession, carrying concealed, related counts
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal granted; appeal dismissed, per reasons for judgment of Derrick, J.A.
mitigating_quote: Systemic racism was identified in Mr. Anderson’s experience: the judge heard evidence about it and, as I will describe, its reality was reflected in her approach to his sentence.
note: Crown appeal of conditional sentence dismissed; CSO length shown only as 'two...', assumed two years less a day; IRCA considered.

name: R. v. Jones
offence_description: Home invasion
sentence_quote: This was a serious home invasion for which Mr. Jones received a sentence at the very low end of the range.
mitigating_quote: That sentence reflected his aboriginal heritage, the delay in the proceedings leading to his guilty plea, and his medical condition.
note: Jail length not stated; pre-sentence custody credited one for one.

name: R. v. Soderberg
offence_description: Loaded firearms possession, prohibited driving, firearm while prohibited, breach of release
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a global sentence of five years and a fine of $1,000.
mitigating_quote: Those factors include: a) instability, family dysfunction and abandonment; b) normalization of drug use and addiction; c) lack of stable housing and personal safety; and d) intergenerational trauma. [84] I find that Mr. Soderberg's moral blameworthiness is diminished by these factors
note: After credit 20 months plus 6 months consecutive; s.743.2 order to forward reports to CSC.

name: R. v. Carvery
offence_description: Trafficking in cocaine and possession for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I therefore sentence you Mr. Carver to serve a two-year sentence concurrent on both counts in a federal penitentiary.
note: 228 days strict house arrest put in the mix as mitigating.

name: R. v. Austin
offence_description: Firearms prohibition order; underlying offence not shown
sentence_quote: to allow this appeal, set aside the order of the Court of Appeal and restore the trial judge's order.
note: Crown appeal restores ten-year firearms prohibition; offence and jail term not shown.

name: R. v. Bomba
offence_description: Break and enter of mobile home; possession of break-in tool
sentence_quote: For the offences and the offender the sentence was well within the appropriate range and entirely fit.
note: Concurrent nine months for possession of blowtorch; leave granted, appeal dismissed.

name: R. v. Megill
offence_description: Possession for trafficking of several drugs; possession of proceeds
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal sentence but dismiss the appeal from sentence except to the extent that I would set aside the victim surcharge of $1,600.
note: Mental health rejected as mitigating; victim surcharge set aside.

name: R. v. Nguyen
offence_description: Two first-degree murders and two attempted murders
sentence_quote: In respect of Count 1, the first-degree murder of Jagvir Malhi, I sentence you to life imprisonment with no eligibility for parole until the expiry of 25 years.
note: Life concurrent on all four counts; lifetime weapons prohibition.

name: R. v. Odo
offence_description: Break and enter into a dwelling
sentence_quote: The court is going to order and direct that you be imprisoned in a federal institution for a period of two years plus a day.
note: Joint submission; no prior break-and-enter findings treated as mitigating; $300 surcharge.

name: R. v. Martin
offence_description: Break and enter, threatening, possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: I would give credit for 32 days to attach to the six month sentence for the break and enter.
note: Eight months total (6+1+1 consecutive); appeal allowed only to give 32 days pre-sentence custody credit.

name: R. v. Bedard
offence_description: Manslaughter of fellow inmate; dangerous offender designation
sentence_quote: I would also dismiss the appeal from the sentence of imprisonment for an indeterminate term imposed as a result of the dangerous offender finding.
note: Dual status offender also under Review Board detention at Oak Ridge (NCRMD), not part of sentence.

name: R. v. Harrison
offence_description: Marijuana grow operation: production and possession for trafficking
co_offenders: N. McVannell: 10 months jail; S. McVannell: 14 months conditional sentence
sentence_quote: In my view, the circumstances here justify the sentence requested by the Crown, namely three years imprisonment.
note: Harrison committed offence while serving conditional sentence for same offence.

name: R. v. Nguyen
offence_description: Marihuana production, possession for trafficking, theft of electricity
sentence_quote: I conclude that a sentence of 12 months is appropriate and I impose that as the sentence in this case.
note: House forfeited; co-accused wife acquitted; lifetime s. 109 prohibition.

name: R. v. E.T.
offence_description: Sexual assault, gross indecency, sexual exploitation of young girl
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted but the appeal is dismissed.
note: Corollary orders imposed at trial but not specified.

name: R. v. Oliver
offence_description: Human trafficking of minors, sexual interference, child pornography, sexual assault
sentence_quote: accepting the joint recommendation of a total sentence of eight years. It will be less time served of 840 days, leaving a period of just under six years remaining.
note: Joint recommendation; mandatory minimums consecutive; lifetime s. 109 order.

name: R. v. Iamkhong
offence_description: Criminal negligence causing bodily harm and aggravated assault (HIV transmission)
sentence_quote: I would set aside the sentence of two years imprisonment imposed at trial and substitute a sentence of two years less one day.
note: Trial judge also gave one year credit for strict bail conditions; reduced by one day for immigration reasons.

name: R. v. Ghiorghita
offence_description: Second degree murder of wife
sentence_quote: I sentence you to life imprisonment for the second degree murder of Andra Ghiorghita. I have determined that the principles of sentencing will be met by a period of parole ineligibility of 10 years.
note: Sentencing for parole ineligibility only; life mandatory.

name: R. v. Oryia
offence_description: Possession of cocaine for trafficking; possession of proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: I would, therefore, substitute a sentence of time served, inclusive of 32 days’ pre-sentence credit, for a total of 347 days’ incarceration, followed by a conditional sentence of 382 days.
note: Original 2 years less 32 days credit; varied to time served plus conditional sentence; global 2 years less a day; house arrest.

name: R. v. McDonald
offence_description: Sexual assault causing bodily harm, unlawful confinement, uttering death threat
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal against sentence and quash the order declaring the appellant a dangerous offender as well as the indeterminate sentence. I would order a new dangerous offender hearing.
note: New dangerous offender hearing ordered; conviction appeal dismissed.

name: R. v. Leppard
offence_description: Threatening death, breach of probation, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: We grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal and vary the sentence to time served.
note: Four years reduced to time served, about 35 months already served.

name: R. v. J.D.
offence_description: Sexual assault of wife's niece, abuse of trust
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a sentence of three years’ imprisonment.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted but dismissed.

name: R. v. Slingerland
offence_description: Four counts of indecent assault by physician
sentence_quote: The appeals against conviction and sentence are dismissed as abated appeals without any adjudication of their merits.
note: Appellant died; appeal abated. Trial sentence was two years imprisonment.

name: R. v. Alves
offence_description: Break and enter with theft; breach of probation and recognizance
sentence_quote: He was given ten months credit for eight and a half months of pre-trial custody, resulting in a global sentence of 44 months.
note: 3.5 years plus 1 year consecutive computed as 54 months before credit.

name: R. v. T.J.W.
offence_description: Theft of chocolate bars; theft of motor vehicle (youth)
sentence_quote: 12 months for auto theft is a high sentence for a 14 year old but it is not, in my view, excessive
note: Youth 14; 12 months open custody concurrent plus 12 months probation; appeal dismissed.

name: R. v. M.P.S.
offence_description: Six counts of sexual misconduct against two step-granddaughters
sentence_quote: I order a global period of eight years' incarceration.
note: Ancillary orders not shown.

name: R. v. Williams
offence_description: Possession of cocaine and fentanyl for trafficking; breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: reducing the global sentence from 51 months to 49 months
note: Credit 825 days Summers plus 2 months Duncan credit applied on appeal.

name: R. v. Morris
offence_description: Threatening, assault, pointing firearm, unlawful confinement of common law wife
sentence_quote: I would allow the Crown's appeal and impose a sentence comprised of a custodial term of 12 months and a term of probation for two years on the terms ordered by the sentencing judge, as varied above
note: Crown appeal replaced suspended sentence with 12 months; 60 hours community work is a probation term.

name: R. v. Smith
offence_description: Pointing firearm, assault causing bodily harm, assaults on wife
sentence_quote: The accused will therefore serve the balance of the 9 month sentence imposed in custody and shall arrange for a time to surrender
note: Crown appeal: nine month conditional sentence converted to custody; probation and s.100 order remain.

name: R. v. Lanktree
offence_description: Methamphetamine trafficking, weapons offences, driving while prohibited
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to 5 years (60 months) in prison less 9 months of Summers credit for pre-sentence custody
note: Appeal dismissed; Duncan credit refused.

name: R. v. Knight
offence_description: Sexual interference with child over six years
sentence_quote: While leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal as to sentence is also dismissed.
note: Sentence of two years less a day; conditional sentence was rejected at trial.

name: R. v. F.W.M.
offence_description: Indecent act and exposing genitals to persons under 16
sentence_quote: He was sentenced on February 11, 2014 to 14 months' imprisonment before credit for time served and to a three-year probation order.
note: Two vague probation conditions amended; jail term and probation length unchanged.

name: R. v. Ruiz
offence_description: Possession of methamphetamine for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: He ultimately imposed an intermittent 90-day sentence with a probation period of 18 months.
note: Intermittent sentence on weekends.

name: R. v. Sor
offence_description: Manslaughter by stabbing
sentence_quote: I sentence you, sir, to prison for two and a half years or 30 months, less credit of 90 days for time served, for a net sentence of 27 months.
note: Victim surcharge waived; no-contact order during custody.

name: R. v. J.A.C.
offence_description: Sexual interference of 14 year old; sexual assault conditionally stayed
sentence_quote: I sentence you to four years imprisonment, less 53 days' credit for 35 days of pre-sentence custody, for the conviction of the offence on Count 2.
mitigating_quote: I find J.A.C. has Indigenous heritage for the purposes of a Gladue assessment and has been the recipient of some intergenerational trauma relevant to Gladue considerations, experienced during his life as a child, which is plausibly associated with substance abuse
note: Gladue letter filed; weight given not shown in excerpts.

name: R. v. Hawkins
offence_description: Trafficking in substance held out to be cocaine; breach of conditional sentence
sentence_quote: Substituted for it is an order suspending the order of Mr. Justice Bauman for four months with the conditional sentence to continue thereafter without any change to its terms.
note: Termination of one year conditional sentence replaced by four month suspension, then continues in community.

name: R. v. Dennis
offence_description: Manslaughter with a firearm
sentence_quote: I am satisfied that a sentence of nine (9) years is proportionate in the unique individualized circumstances of this case.
mitigating_quote: In particular, it addresses the effects of intergenerational and personal trauma, addiction, the legacy of the residential school system, and the challenges associated with growing up in a marginalized First Nation community.
note: Co-accused Gould and Michael not sentenced in this decision.

name: R. v. Amuthan
offence_description: Possession of cocaine for trafficking; possession of proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: Mr. Nagaratnam received an individualized sentence that was well within the range for mid-level cocaine trafficking.
note: Only Nagaratnam's sentence (3 years 1.5 months) appealed; Amuthan's sentence not shown.

name: R. v. Macdonald
offence_description: Vehicle taking, theft, stolen plate, refusal, failures to appear, breach, obstruction
sentence_quote: The court sentences Ms Macdonald to a 30-day term of imprisonment for the refusal count; however, the court grants a 30-day credit for her remand time, so that the sentence is deemed to have been served in full.
note: Suspended sentence with 18 months probation on remaining counts; restitution declined.

name: R. v. Kumar
offence_description: Trafficking cocaine and possession for trafficking, dial-a-dope
sentence_quote: I am satisfied that the accused should be sentenced on Count 1 to a period of six months' imprisonment and on Count 2 to a period of six months' imprisonment.
note: Concurrent six month terms; victim surcharge waived.

name: R. v. M.A.
offence_description: Apparently sexual offences against children; not specified in text
sentence_quote: On the sentence appeal, for the reasons set out in the Crown’s factum, the sentence was fit.
note: Sentence length and offences not stated; inferred from publication ban and child complainants.

name: R. v. Taylor
offence_description: Impaired driving causing death and bodily harm; failure to stop
sentence_quote: The appellant applies for leave to appeal and to appeal against a total sentence of four years for driving offences
note: 3.5 years, 2 years concurrent, 6 months consecutive; trial judge rejected joint submission; treatment in custody urged.

name: R. v. Quilt
offence_description: Two aggravated assaults with knife; uttering a threat
sentence_quote: I have sentenced you to eight months in jail, and then I have put you on probation for two years after your release from jail.
mitigating_quote: I am well aware of the proposition that incarceration is to be applied sparingly, judiciously, and that special concerns apply with respect to Aboriginal offenders.
note: Eight months concurrent on each count; 10-year s. 109 prohibition; community work 30 hours is a probation condition.

name: R. v. Williams
offence_description: Manslaughter by stabbing half-brother
sentence_quote: you are sentenced to a term of four years' imprisonment
mitigating_quote: Appreciation of the 'systemic and background factors', including the exposure of his parents to the residential school system and the consequent struggles of many Nuu-chah-nulth people with family violence and abuse and substance misuse, does indeed help put in proper context
note: Joint submission accepted; one-for-one credit for 81 days; s. 114 surrender order; surcharge waived.

name: R. v. Win
offence_description: Seven counts of trafficking cocaine
sentence_quote: I am impose concurrent sentences of 15 months in imprisonment with respect to each of the seven counts of trafficking for which you have been convicted.
note: Court did not expressly list mitigating factors; conditional sentence refused.

name: R. v. Cargioli
offence_description: Second degree murder of Shadi Taleb during planned robbery
co_offenders: Morrisson: life, parole ineligibility 15 years, appeal dismissed; Cargioli: second degree murder conviction substituted, sentencing pending
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced Mr. Kamal to life imprisonment without parole eligibility for 14 years.
note: Kamal taken as first sentenced; Cargioli not yet sentenced.

name: R. v. Hanifan
offence_description: Manslaughter by single punch
sentence_quote: He was convicted on January 28, 1999 and was subsequently sentenced to six years imprisonment.
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed.

name: R. v. D.M.
offence_description: Sexual assault of 16-year-old niece
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to six months imprisonment in a correctional facility, followed by two years probation.
note: Conditional sentence rejected; leave granted, sentence appeal dismissed.

name: R. v. Wawrykiewicz
offence_description: Possession for trafficking cocaine, heroin; multiple drug offences
sentence_quote: He was given a global sentence of 10 years, less 353 days of credit for pre-sentence custody and strict house arrest bail conditions.
note: Credit of 353 days includes 90 days for house arrest bail conditions.

name: R. v. Wheatley
offence_description: Breach of long-term supervision order residency condition
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal, and reduce the effective sentence on the breach of the long-term supervision order to 15 months.
mitigating_quote: The sentencing judge erred in failing to particularly consider Mr. Wheatley's Aboriginal circumstances and the Gladue factors. The sentence she imposed was, in my view, unfit as a consequence of this failure.
note: Effective sentence 15 months; 2 months consecutive on separate offence not part of this count.

name: R. v. Rektor
offence_description: Four counts of assault on spouse
sentence_quote: The sentences for these four counts are to be served consecutively for a total sentence of 33 months of imprisonment.
note: Victim surcharge waived; s. 110 prohibition for ten years.

name: R. v. May
offence_description: Attempted murder with firearm, firearm possession, flight from police
sentence_quote: On count 1 of the Indictment, the attempted murder of Dean Jones, I am sentencing you to 9‑1/2 years' imprisonment.
note: Concurrent sentences; driving prohibition two years plus imprisonment term; credit 1.5 to one.

name: R. v. Smith
offence_description: Sexual assault (rape) of acquaintance in 2010
sentence_quote: To account for the collateral circumstances, I reduce Mr. Smith's sentence from two years and eight months to two years and seven months.
note: Deportation consequence gave one-month reduction; court found no mitigating factors otherwise.

name: R. v. Hartling
offence_description: Aggravated assault, assault causing bodily harm, breach of probation
sentence_quote: He was given a global sentenced of 30 months in custody.
mitigating_quote: The trial judge's reasons for sentence provided due consideration to the relevant aggravating and mitigating factors, including the Gladue report. I see no error in principle.
note: Sentence appeal allowed in part for s. 11(b) delay; reduced length not shown. Original 30 months.

name: R. v. Mohamed
offence_description: Trafficking and possession for trafficking cocaine, offering to sell, proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to 20 months imprisonment after credit of 28 months for pre-sentence custody, and three years probation.
note: Total 48 months derived from 20 months plus 28 months credit.

name: R. v. Fuller
offence_description: Theft of truck, possession of stolen truck, possession of break-in instrument
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, but dismiss the appeal.
note: Global five years includes 17 months credit; 43 months imposed after credit.

name: R. v. P.W.R.
offence_description: Sexual touching of person under 16 (sexual assault conditionally stayed)
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a term of incarceration of two years less one day, plus three years of probation.
mitigating_quote: A lengthy term of imprisonment risks accentuating the intergenerational trauma of colonization that has contributed to Mr. R. being before the court today.
note: Victim surcharge waived for hardship; SOIRA 20 years.

name: R. v. Kwakye
offence_description: Manslaughter during home invasion robbery
sentence_quote: we would vary the sentence imposed from 10 years to seven years.
note: Credit includes pre-trial custody and bail.

name: R. v. S.B.T.
offence_description: Sexual assault of two young nieces
sentence_quote: I would grant leave but would dismiss the appeal.
note: Six months and twelve months consecutive.

name: R. v. Siek
offence_description: Marihuana production, possession for trafficking, diverting electricity
sentence_quote: sentenced the respondent to two years in a federal penitentiary in respect of the production charge
note: Crown appeal allowed only to order forfeiture of the property; jail sentence unchanged.

name: R. v. Campeau
offence_description: Arson endangering life
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted but the appeal is dismissed.

name: R. v. Champion
offence_description: Fraud of church members, including elderly couple
sentence_quote: We are satisfied that the twelve months custodial sentence imposed at trial was within the appropriate range and entirely fit.
note: Trial judge wrongly used lack of remorse as aggravating; sentence still fit.

name: R. v. Peepre
offence_description: Participation in riot and assault simpliciter
sentence_quote: the judge sentenced Mr. Peepre to a 60-day intermittent prison sentence on both counts concurrently plus 18 months probation
note: Crown sentence appeal dismissed.

name: R. v. Yews
offence_description: Two sexual assaults and extortion
sentence_quote: The learned judge imposed a sentence of two years less a day.
note: Appeal allowed only to add no-contact term to probation.

name: R. v. Bruce
offence_description: Offences not shown
sentence_quote: The conditional sentence will be for a period of 583 days
note: Joint submission; sentence varied to conditional sentence; offence and conditions not shown.

name: R. v. G.F.
offence_description: Sexual assault of 16-year-old at campground
co_offenders: R.B.: 3 years
sentence_quote: While we would grant leave to appeal the sentences, the appeals are dismissed.
note: G.F. three and one-half years.

name: R. v. Huete

offence_description: Second degree murder of her eight-year-old daughter
sentence_quote: convicted of second degree murder and sentenced to life imprisonment without eligibility for parole for 15 years.

name: R. v. Therrien
offence_description: Fraud over $5000 against employer
sentence_quote: we grant leave to appeal sentence but dismiss the sentence appeal.
note: Conviction appeal also dismissed.

name: R. v. L., G.
offence_description: Sexual touching and sexual assault of 13-year-old sister-in-law
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a 10-month sentence of imprisonment to be followed by probation for three years.
note: Trial judge erred relying on youth record, but sentence still found fit; 49 days already served.

name: R. v. Lo Verde
offence_description: Sexual assault of police officer; forcible entry (substituted for break and enter)
sentence_quote: While leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal against sentence is dismissed. The victim fine surcharge is set aside on consent.
note: Time served on sexual assault; surcharge set aside; forcible entry substituted on conviction appeal.

name: R. v. Read
offence_description: Theft of cocaine by police exhibit custodian
sentence_quote: I am still unable to say that the 14-month period of incarceration for this offence and offender is unfit.
note: Breach of trust aggravating; conditional sentence rejected.

name: R. v. Reed
offence_description: Attempted murder with firearm
sentence_quote: In all of the circumstances, I find the joint submission for ten years is appropriate.
note: Joint submission accepted; already serving life for murder; reasons forwarded to CSC.

name: R. v. Kreiger
offence_description: Second-degree murder
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted, but the appeal is dismissed.
note: Co-accused's 20-year ineligibility dealt with in separate reasons.

name: R. v. Iverson
offence_description: Production and possession for trafficking of methamphetamine and ecstasy
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal and allow the appeal to the extent of substituting four sentences of five years of imprisonment for the four sentences of six years imposed by the trial judge, all counts running concurrent.
note: Six years reduced to five, concurrent.

name: R. v. Thiara
offence_description: Attempted murder; carrying concealed firearm
sentence_quote: In my view, the appropriate sentence is ten years in prison for the charge of attempt murder, with three years concurrent to be served for the charge of carrying a concealed weapon.
note: Would have been twelve years but for youth, remorse, progress.

name: R. v. Currie
offence_description: Two counts possession for trafficking; breach of probation
sentence_quote: This results in a total sentence of two years plus one day.
note: Joint submission; victim surcharge waived for hardship.

name: R. v. Fam
offence_description: Offences not shown
sentence_quote: We reduce the sentence to one of two years less a day imprisonment concurrent on each count.
note: Reduced from two years to avoid immigration consequences; offences not stated.

name: R. v. Bawa
offence_description: Robbery and aggravated assault by stabbing
sentence_quote: I am going to impose a sentence of 27 months' federal time, which after consideration of the immigration consequences and the house arrest which you have endured for the last couple of years, I will reduce to a period of 24 months
note: Credit of 17 days is in addition to the 24 months; 10-year s.109 prohibition.

name: R. v. Simoni
offence_description: Break and enter and theft in bank vault break-in

note: Co-defendant Papic received same term after guilty plea; counts described as two counts of breaking and entering.

name: R. v. Allard
offence_description: Arson and two counts of threatening
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to two years less a day imprisonment on his conviction for arson, probation for three years, and an order to pay restitution of $14,000 to the victim of the fire.
note: Threats: 3 months and 1 year concurrent; 13 months pre-trial custody, judge treated as about 26 months.

name: R. v. Goodliffe
offence_description: Sexual assault of intoxicated 17-year-old
sentence_quote: In my opinion, the sentence of 27 months in prison was fit at the time it was imposed, and continues to be a fit sentence today.
note: Decision gives 27 months and also says 30 months effective after three months credit; inconsistent.

name: R. v. Brushett
offence_description: Second-degree murder by shooting stepfather
sentence_quote: Tyere Brushett’s parole ineligibility is set at 13 years, that is, he must serve 13 years before he can apply for parole.
mitigating_quote: but also considering the mitigating factor of his very challenging background as described in the IRCA, I agree with the Crown that the appropriate period for parole ineligibility is 13 years.
note: Parole ineligibility decision after jury verdict; life sentence automatic.

name: R. v. Demirovic
offence_description: Importing heroin and possession for trafficking
sentence_quote: On Count 2, importing heroin, I sentence you to four years' imprisonment. On Count 1, possession of heroin for the purpose of trafficking, I sentence you to three years' imprisonment.
note: Absence of profit motive treated as mitigating; concurrent sentences.

name: R. v. Boudreau
offence_description: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I sentence you to serve a period of four years custody.
note: Other orders were granted earlier and are not shown.

name: R. v. Sutherland
offence_description: Sexual assault with weapon, assault causing bodily harm, theft, breach of probation
sentence_quote: The sentence is not demonstrably unfit and reflects no error in principle or disproportionate emphasis on any relevant factor.
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed.

name: R. v. Abdelrazzaq
offence_description: Possession of cocaine for trafficking; possession of proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal. The fine in lieu of forfeiture provisions are not contrary to s. 12 of the Charter.
note: Crown appeal on fine in lieu of forfeiture; fine not yet decided; jail 3y 8m net not in issue.

name: R. v. Pooli
offence_description: Driving while prohibited, breaches, other offences on five informations

note: Not all seven offences are shown; co-accused sentenced separately; four driving prohibitions of unstated length.

name: R. v. Morgan
offence_description: Offences not shown in the endorsement
sentence_quote: we do not feel that the interests of justice would be served by altering the sentence at this time.
note: Conditional sentence held unfit but left undisturbed given fresh evidence; length not shown.

name: R. v. Holding
offence_description: Dangerous driving causing death during epileptic seizure
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed and the sentence of nine months will be served by way of a conditional sentence.
note: Two years less a day jail replaced by nine-month conditional sentence; 49 days credit deducted.

name: R. v. Gibson
offence_description: Offences not shown in addendum

note: Addendum only; sentence appeal allowed earlier, original sentence not shown.

name: R. v. Kalmikoff
offence_description: Two firearm robberies, failing to stop for police, possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: I think the denunciatory, deterrent and rehabilitative objectives of sentencing will be met by a term of imprisonment of 4 years 9 months.
note: Count 4 stayed; count 2 acquitted.

name: R. v. Atanassov
offence_description: Sexual interference of two girls and making child pornography
sentence_quote: On Count 1 of the Indictment, the sexual interference of L.B. and N.G., I sentence you to three years and six months' imprisonment.
note: Count 2 one year consecutive; global 4y6m; s.743.2 order forwarding reports; surcharge waived.

name: R. v. Gowlett
offence_description: Possession for trafficking of cocaine and fentanyl
sentence_quote: on each of Counts 1 and 2 on the indictment I sentence you to a term of imprisonment of four years, to be served concurrently.
note: Co-accused McMillan sentenced separately; surcharge waived.

name: R. v. Chambers
offence_description: Aggravated assault, two assaults with weapon, dangerous driving
sentence_quote: For the offence of aggravated assault, I sentence you to a period of incarceration of one year.
note: Concurrent terms; probation includes curfew; driving prohibition declined.

name: R. v. Toor
offence_description: Robbery with firearm, confinement, weapon possession, break and enter

note: Unclear whether 3y global is before or after the roughly three years credit; co-accused not sentenced here.

name: R. v. Lavergne
offence_description: Sexual assault and sexual exploitation by a high school teacher

name: R. v. Cross
offence_description: Loaded restricted handgun, removed serial number, concealed weapon

note: Crown appeal; illegal 12-month conditional sentence replaced by time served plus probation.

name: R. v. Alagendra
offence_description: Aggravated assault with a machete, racially motivated

name: R. v. Iafrate
offence_description: Driving offence with lengthy driving prohibition; details not shown

name: R. v. Capstick
offence_description: Assault with a weapon (broom handle) on eight-year-old son

name: R. v. McCullough

note: Second degree murder conviction quashed, new trial ordered; counselling sentence cut from 10 years.

name: R. v. Yeck
offence_description: Assault (choking victim unconscious)

note: Sentence appeal dismissed.

name: R. v. Frank
offence_description: Breaches of no-contact orders, mischief, criminal harassment

name: R. v. Harmes
offence_description: Possession for trafficking of seven drugs; firearms offences; breach of firearms prohibitions
sentence_quote: Balancing all of the relevant factors, I am of the view that a global sentence of 14 years is a proportionate, fit, and proper sentence.
note: 12 years plus 2 years consecutive; credit 651 days at 1.5:1.

name: R. v. Berry

note: Only Isaac's sentence reviewed; Daye's six-year sentence not appealed. Credit amount not shown.

name: R. v. Francis
offence_description: Loaded firearm possession; possession of drugs for trafficking

name: R. v. Carvery
offence_description: Possession of cocaine for trafficking; breach of recognizance

note: Crown appeal on 1.5:1 credit rejected; only publication ban removed. Credit amount not shown.

offence_description: Manslaughter of common-law partner by stabbing

note: Joint submission accepted; victim surcharge waived.

name: R. v. Kusi
offence_description: Robbery of a taxi driver

note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted and dismissed.

note: Crown appeal about refusal of $4.7M fine dismissed.

note: 20 months plus 6 months concurrent; credit 1:1 for 165 days.

co_offenders: G.R.: same 3 year youth sentence; L.Z.: adult life sentence, parole ineligibility 7 years

note: Appeal of consecutive 8 month term dismissed.

offence_description: Publication ban ruling in murder trial; no sentence
note: Ruling on deferred publication ban during trial.

offence_description: Importing cocaine (two couriers)
co_offenders: Mason: conditional sentence of 2 years less a day

note: Crown appeal allowed in principle (jail was fit) but conditional sentences left to stand; appeal dismissed.

offence_description: Intimidating justice participant and uttering threats

note: Guilty pleas struck; new trial ordered. Original sentence was 3 years.

name: R. v. Rana
offence_description: Sexual assault
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted, but the sentence appeal is dismissed.
note: Sentence terms not stated in the text shown.

name: R. v. Alexander

name: R. v. Anderson

note: Victim surcharge waived. Separate earlier arson sentence not included.

name: R. v. Balmes

name: R. v. E.M.G.

name: R. v. Rosov

name: R. v. Lonegren

name: R. v. Fenton
offence_description: Breach of probation order (possession of alcohol)
note: Crown appeal allowed, conviction entered, matter sent back to trial judge for sentencing.

name: R. v. Bradford

note: Only conviction appealed; dismissed. Co-accused also convicted, sentences not stated.

name: R. v. Carter

name: R. v. Witen

name: R. v. Halladay-Runions

name: R. v. West

note: Attempted murder 13 years concurrent; credit 1.5:1 applied to that count, 1,946 days remaining. Co-accused sentenced earlier.

name: R. v. McCallum
offence_description: Sexual assault causing bodily harm; dangerous offender application

note: Crown appeal allowed; new sentencing hearing ordered.

name: R. v. Akumu
offence_description: Sexual interference, invitation to sexual touching, householder permitting prohibited sexual activity

note: Deafness and immigration consequences considered; concurrent sentences.

name: R. v. Christink

name: R. v. K.M.

name: R. v. Alec

name: R. v. N.J.

name: R. v. Gan

name: R. v. Balkissoon
offence_description: Sexual assault

name: R. v. Andersen

note: Majority varies sentence to years less a day (number not shown); Green J.A. dissent ignored; Inuk offender.

name: R. v. T.L.P.

name: R. v. E.H.

name: R. v. Burnett

name: R. v. Masters
